slug: 2025-11-09 Government Finalizes Sierra Leones Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill

facts.fact: The Information Minister announced that the Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill, 2025 had concluded its final national validation, with submission to Cabinet and then Parliament still to come; the week of the validation is taken from the article's publication on 9 November 2025.
facts.system: Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill

facts.fact: The Bill would establish for the first time a single independent authority responsible for both data protection and access to information; it is not yet constituted as the Bill is unenacted.
facts.system: Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill
